en.headline: Three public condolence points open today for Tung Chee-hwa
en.dek: The Home Affairs Department is opening venues in Causeway Bay, Kai Tak and Tsuen Wan for residents to sign condolence books through Sunday noon.
body: Three public condolence points open on Friday for residents to sign books mourning Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first Chief Executive, who died on 8 September aged 89.

The Home Affairs Department said the books will be available from 9am to 9pm on Friday and Saturday, and from 9am to noon on Sunday, at Moreton Terrace Activities Centre at 20 Tung Lo Wan Drive, Causeway Bay; Kai Tak Community Hall at 3 Concorde Road; and the multi-purpose room at Sai Lau Kok Garden on Sai Lau Kok Road, Tsuen Wan.

A wake is scheduled for Saturday afternoon at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, with a memorial and encoffining ceremony on Sunday morning. The Office of Former Chief Executives has said seating at the Sunday service is limited to invited guests. Separate temporary traffic measures will apply around the funeral home over the weekend.

zh.headline: 董建華公眾凱唧處今日開放 銅鑼灣啟德荃灣設點
zh.dek: 民政事務總署在銅鑼灣摩頓台、啟德社區會堂及荃灣西樓角花園開設凱唧處，供市民簽署凱唧冊至周日中午。
body: 三個公眾凱唧處周五起開放，供市民簽署凱唧冊，悼念於9月8日逝世、享年89歲的首任行政長官董建華。
民政事務總署表示，凱唧冊於周五及周六上午9時至晚上9時開放簽署，周日則由上午9時至中午12時。地點分別為銅鑼灣銅鑼灣道20號摩頓台活動中心、啟德協調道3號啟德社區會堂，以及荃灣西樓角道西樓角花園多用途室。
設靈定於周六下午在北角香港殯儀館舉行，周日上午舉行公祭及大殓。前任行政長官辦公室表示，周日儀式場地有限，只供獲邀人士出席。殯儀館一帶周末另有臨時交通安排。
